svg.text: Spin-charge separation — Hubbard chain, U=4t, half filling (T=0)
fast block path (packed two-U(1)), N=64, real-time TEBD after (2Sz)/(n−1) source at l0=32; ED-validated correlators
Same ground state, two probes: the spin response is gapless at k=π (spinons, J_eff=4t²/U) while the charge response is pushed above the Mott gap (holons) — spin–charge separation.
